project_context.description: B2B supplier of food containers, eco-friendly disposables, and hygiene/housekeeping supplies based in Chennai.
project_context.theme: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level, premium, bold, kinetic. Rounded-corner, soft-shadow 'pill and card' visual language.

primary_accent.name: Sandy/Sunflower Yellow
primary_accent.usage: Primary accent, subtle highlights, select CTA backgrounds

surface_primary.name: Pastel Green
surface_primary.usage: Primary supporting color across backgrounds, panel accents

surface_secondary.name: Pistachio Green
surface_secondary.usage: Lighter supporting surface color, soft cards

ink.name: Ink
ink.usage: Primary text, near-black for high contrast

background_base.name: Background
background_base.usage: Main page background, off-white clean readability

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-bold tracking-tighter leading-none text-[#1A1C19]

typography.instructions: Use Plus Jakarta Sans globally. Maintain tight tracking on headings for a premium, bold feel. Use Font Awesome 6 for all icons.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid heavy transparent dark glass. Use white/off-white translucent panels: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#E0E5DD].
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E0E5DD (line) to define card edges cleanly alongside the soft shadow.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Extremely generous padding. Use py-24 or py-32 for section spacing. Use gap-8 or gap-12 for grids.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For 'Our Story' or 'Categories', use an asymmetrical bento grid (e.g., grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with col-span variations like col-span-8 and col-span-4).
grids_and_layouts.product_grid: E-Catalog uses uniform, highly structured 3-column or 4-column grids with pill filters cleanly aligned above.

components.hero_carousel: Auto-rotating. Kinetic masked line-by-line reveal for text (using framer-motion). Subtly scaling background image for parallax effect. Use dot/arrow nav treated as floating glass pills.
components.marquee: Slow editorial marquee using framer-motion or react-fast-marquee. Use large outline text or elegant typography with dots/icons separating brand highlights.
components.category_cards: Soft-shadow, jumbo-radius cards with real product photography spotlighted. Include 'View E-Catalog' CTAs in secondary accent color (Sunset Orange).
components.filter_pills: E-Catalog filters (Eco-friendly, Plastic, Paper, etc.). Pill-shaped, active state uses Pistachio Green or Sunset Orange.
components.manifesto_chapters: Numbered list layout for About page (mission/vision). Massive typography for the numbers (e.g., '01', '02' in Sandy Yellow), offset with text.
components.cta_banner: Need a Custom Quote banner. Full width, jumbo rounded corners, heavily utilizing the primary Green or Yellow backgrounds with bold contrasting typography.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Implement Lenis for smooth, momentum-based scrolling. Critical for the 'award-worthy' feel.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion. Elements should fade in and slide up slightly (e.g., y: 30, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1) on scroll.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Cards lift on hover (-translate-y-2) and shadows expand. Buttons scale down slightly on tap (scale: 0.95).
motion_and_interactions.hero_load: Text must use overflow hidden and animate line-by-line from bottom to top on mount.

media_and_assets.image_treatment: Spotlight effect. Where possible, show product images clearly clipped or within aesthetic framed windows (rounded-3xl). Avoid edge-to-edge images unless in hero.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Ink (#1A1C19) or Ink2 (#5C6159) is used for text against the light backgrounds (Pastel/Pistachio Green, Yellow, Surf). Do NOT use white text on Pastel Green unless verified with shadow.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for Framer Motion animations. Add accessible labels to Font Awesome icons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You are building an Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level B2B platform. Avoid generic, template-like structures.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling and Framer Motion for line-by-line text reveals and scroll-triggered animations.

Strictly follow the color palette: Surface backgrounds lean towards Pastel Green (#93C572) and Pistachio Green (#BAED91), with White (#FFFFFF) cards. Accents are Sandy Yellow (#FFDA03) and Sunset Orange (#FD5E53).
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' font exclusively, with Font Awesome 6 for icons.
Cards and primary container elements must use the 'jumbo' 3rem border radius where appropriate to match the pill-and-card visual language.
DO NOT apply generic 'transition: all' globally. Animate transforms and opacities directly.
DO NOT center align large blocks of text; stick to left-aligned geometric precision unless in explicit hero/banner text.
NO pure transparent backgrounds under headers. Use glassmorphism or solid backgrounds.
Code files must be .js / .jsx (React + Tailwind) as per the repository structure. Do NOT use .tsx.
Always provide data-testid for buttons, links, inputs, and interactive elements for testing.
